title: Gemini texted at 7. It's 1 a.m. now.
caption: Sent "had fun today!" at 7. In 2016 Gemini refreshed until 1 a.m. and called their own phone to check it worked. In 2026 the phone went in a drawer and the reply waited for breakfast. Which era are you texting from?
